entries.subject: their account

spans.text: [1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مُّعْرِضُونَ EN: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.

spans.text: [4] AR: قَالَ رَبِّى يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ EN: The Prophet said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."

entries.description: he has invented it
entries.subject: he

spans.text: [5] AR: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَٰثُ أَحْلَٰمٍۭ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌۭ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٍۢ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ EN: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet.

entries.description: the previous were sent [with miracles]
entries.subject: the previous

spans.text: So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."

entries.description: which We destroyed believed before them
entries.subject: which We

spans.text: [6] AR: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَآ ۖ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ EN: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?

entries.description: And We sent not before you
entries.subject: And We

spans.text: [7] AR: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًۭا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ EN: And We sent not before you, [O Muhammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message if you do not know.

[25] AR: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ EN: And We sent not before you any messenger except that We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."

entries.description: whom We revealed [the message]
entries.subject: whom We

spans.text: [7] AR: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًۭا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ EN: And We sent not before you, [O Muhammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message if you do not know.

spans.text: [8] AR: وَمَا جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ جَسَدًۭا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ خَٰلِدِينَ EN: And We did not make the prophets forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].
[16] AR: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَآءَ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا لَٰعِبِينَ EN: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.

entries.description: nor were they immortal [on earth]

spans.text: [8] AR: وَمَا جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ جَسَدًۭا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ خَٰلِدِينَ EN: And We did not make the prophets forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].

entries.description: Then We fulfilled for them the promise
entries.subject: Then We

spans.text: [9] AR: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ EN: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.

spans.text: [13] AR: لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ EN: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."

spans.text: [17] AR: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًۭا لَّٱتَّخَذْنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ EN: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.

spans.text: [18] AR: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌۭ ۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ EN: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs.

spans.text: [21] AR: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ EN: Or have men taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?

spans.text: [22] AR: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ EN: Had there been within the heavens and earth gods besides Allah, they both would have been ruined.

entries.description: Or have they taken gods besides Him?
entries.subject: Or

spans.text: [24] AR: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةًۭ ۖ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَٰنَكُمْ ۖ هَٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِى ۗ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ EN: Or have they taken gods besides Him?

entries.description: Most Merciful has taken a son
entries.subject: Most Merciful

spans.text: [26] AR: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًۭا ۗ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۚ بَلْ عِبَادٌۭ مُّكْرَمُونَ EN: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son."

entries.object: what is [presently] before them and what will be after them

spans.text: [28] AR: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِۦ مُشْفِقُونَ EN: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves.

entries.description: one We would recompense with Hell
entries.subject: one We

spans.text: [29] AR: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّىٓ إِلَٰهٌۭ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ EN: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him"- that one We would recompense with Hell.

spans.text: [9] AR: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ EN: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.

[7] AR: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًۭا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ EN: And We sent not before you, [O Muhammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message if you do not know.

[25] AR: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا نُوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدُونِ EN: And We sent not before you any messenger except that We revealed to him that, "There is no deity except Me, so worship Me."

folded.id: and we|separated|them and made from water every living thing?
folded.subject: and We
folded.object: them and made from water every living thing?

spans.text: [30] AR: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًۭا فَفَتَقْنَٰهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ ۖ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ EN: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them and made from water every living thing?
Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.

[17] AR: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًۭا لَّٱتَّخَذْنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ EN: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.

[5] AR: بَلْ قَالُوٓا۟ أَضْغَٰثُ أَحْلَٰمٍۭ بَلِ ٱفْتَرَىٰهُ بَلْ هُوَ شَاعِرٌۭ فَلْيَأْتِنَا بِـَٔايَةٍۢ كَمَآ أُرْسِلَ ٱلْأَوَّلُونَ EN: But they say, "[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet.

folded.id: he|knows|what is [presently] before them and what will be after them
folded.subject: He
folded.object: what is [presently] before them and what will be after them

spans.text: [28] AR: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يَشْفَعُونَ إِلَّا لِمَنِ ٱرْتَضَىٰ وَهُم مِّنْ خَشْيَتِهِۦ مُشْفِقُونَ EN: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves.
[26] AR: وَقَالُوا۟ ٱتَّخَذَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنُ وَلَدًۭا ۗ سُبْحَٰنَهُۥ ۚ بَلْ عِبَادٌۭ مُّكْرَمُونَ EN: And they say, "The Most Merciful has taken a son."

folded.id: my lord|knows|whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth
folded.subject: My Lord
folded.object: whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth

spans.text: [4] AR: قَالَ رَبِّى يَعْلَمُ ٱلْقَوْلَ فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ EN: The Prophet said, "My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing."
[8] AR: وَمَا جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ جَسَدًۭا لَّا يَأْكُلُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ خَٰلِدِينَ EN: And We did not make the prophets forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].

folded.id: of theirs|did|not cease until we made them [as] a harvest [mowed down]
folded.subject: of theirs
folded.object: not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down]

spans.text: [15] AR: فَمَا زَالَت تِّلْكَ دَعْوَىٰهُمْ حَتَّىٰ جَعَلْنَٰهُمْ حَصِيدًا خَٰمِدِينَ EN: And that declaration of theirs did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished [like a fire].

[29] AR: ۞ وَمَن يَقُلْ مِنْهُمْ إِنِّىٓ إِلَٰهٌۭ مِّن دُونِهِۦ فَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِيهِ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ EN: And whoever of them should say, "Indeed, I am a god besides Him"- that one We would recompense with Hell.

folded.id: or|have|men taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?
folded.subject: Or
folded.object: men taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?

spans.text: [21] AR: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَةًۭ مِّنَ ٱلْأَرْضِ هُمْ يُنشِرُونَ EN: Or have men taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?

[24] AR: أَمِ ٱتَّخَذُوا۟ مِن دُونِهِۦٓ ءَالِهَةًۭ ۖ قُلْ هَاتُوا۟ بُرْهَٰنَكُمْ ۖ هَٰذَا ذِكْرُ مَن مَّعِىَ وَذِكْرُ مَن قَبْلِى ۗ بَلْ أَكْثَرُهُمْ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ ۖ فَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ EN: Or have they taken gods besides Him?

folded.id: so|would|you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"
folded.subject: So
folded.object: you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"

spans.text: So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?"

[30] AR: أَوَلَمْ يَرَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ كَانَتَا رَتْقًۭا فَفَتَقْنَٰهُمَا ۖ وَجَعَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلْمَآءِ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ حَىٍّ ۖ أَفَلَا يُؤْمِنُونَ EN: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them and made from water every living thing?
So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles]."

[1] AR: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ ٱقْتَرَبَ لِلنَّاسِ حِسَابُهُمْ وَهُمْ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مُّعْرِضُونَ EN: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.

[9] AR: ثُمَّ صَدَقْنَٰهُمُ ٱلْوَعْدَ فَأَنجَيْنَٰهُمْ وَمَن نَّشَآءُ وَأَهْلَكْنَا ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ EN: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.

[22] AR: لَوْ كَانَ فِيهِمَآ ءَالِهَةٌ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ لَفَسَدَتَا ۚ فَسُبْحَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَرْشِ عَمَّا يَصِفُونَ EN: Had there been within the heavens and earth gods besides Allah, they both would have been ruined.

folded.id: was unjust|have|we shattered and produced after it another people
folded.subject: was unjust
folded.object: We shattered and produced after it another people

spans.text: [11] AR: وَكَمْ قَصَمْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍۢ كَانَتْ ظَالِمَةًۭ وَأَنشَأْنَا بَعْدَهَا قَوْمًا ءَاخَرِينَ EN: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people.

folded.id: we could|have|taken it from [what is] with us - if [indeed] we were to do so
folded.subject: We could
folded.object: taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so

spans.text: [17] AR: لَوْ أَرَدْنَآ أَن نَّتَّخِذَ لَهْوًۭا لَّٱتَّخَذْنَٰهُ مِن لَّدُنَّآ إِن كُنَّا فَٰعِلِينَ EN: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.

[18] AR: بَلْ نَقْذِفُ بِٱلْحَقِّ عَلَى ٱلْبَٰطِلِ فَيَدْمَغُهُۥ فَإِذَا هُوَ زَاهِقٌۭ ۚ وَلَكُمُ ٱلْوَيْلُ مِمَّا تَصِفُونَ EN: Rather, We dash the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs.

folded.id: we|have|certainly sent down to you a book in which is your mention
folded.subject: We
folded.object: certainly sent down to you a Book in which is your mention

spans.text: [10] AR: لَقَدْ أَنزَلْنَآ إِلَيْكُمْ كِتَٰبًۭا فِيهِ ذِكْرُكُمْ ۖ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ EN: We have certainly sent down to you a Book in which is your mention.
Indeed, we were wrongdoers."

folded.id: where you|were|given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned
folded.subject: where you
folded.object: given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned

spans.text: [13] AR: لَا تَرْكُضُوا۟ وَٱرْجِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَآ أُتْرِفْتُمْ فِيهِ وَمَسَٰكِنِكُمْ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُسْـَٔلُونَ EN: [Some angels said], "Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes - perhaps you will be questioned."
[6] AR: مَآ ءَامَنَتْ قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْيَةٍ أَهْلَكْنَٰهَآ ۖ أَفَهُمْ يُؤْمِنُونَ EN: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?

[7] AR: وَمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا قَبْلَكَ إِلَّا رِجَالًۭا نُّوحِىٓ إِلَيْهِمْ ۖ فَسْـَٔلُوٓا۟ أَهْلَ ٱلذِّكْرِ إِن كُنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ EN: And We sent not before you, [O Muhammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message if you do not know.
